items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: the bass player had to leave a few days to go back to Philadelphia, I think it was Al Moore.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

band was going to play The Plantation and so that night they had arrived in time to come to the Club to hear the band and myself and I did my solo on "Stardust" and then afterwards my uncle went back stage and met all the boys and met Louie and talked about Blue Island, when I was a kid there and then that same night the bass player had to leave a few days to go back to Philadelphia, I think it was Al Moore. So Joe Garland asked me, "You've been here before with Jeter-Pillars, do you know a good bass player in…
How did you come in contact with him? How did you know about his musical ability?
